newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PUBLIC INVESTMENT SPENDING UP 87PCT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PUBLIC INVESTMENT SPENDING UP 87PCT IN H1.

text.p: Greece's public investment spending rose 87 percent to 528.25 billion drachmas in the first half of the year compared to the same period in 1996, the national economy ministry said in a statement.

Spending from the public investment budget for projects co-financed with the European Union rose 95.8 percent to 337.18 billion drachmas in the first six-months of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, it added.
